observations: Stack of four black Sony PlayStation 4 consoles.
Two red DualShock 4 controllers in retail packaging.
The consoles are stacked on top of each other.
A watermark 'GAME ARENA OFFICIAL' is visible across the center of the image.
A power outlet with two black plugs is visible in the background.
The text 'SONY' is visible on the front of the top console.

claims.evidence: Origin and usage history cannot be confirmed from photos.
The model is not visible on the front of the consoles in the photo.
No games are visible in the photo.
Photo 0 shows two controllers in boxes.

risks.risk: The consoles may be non-functional or have internal damage.
risks.proof: A video showing each console powering on and launching a game.

risks.risk: The consoles may be 'ghost' units or have a 'ghost' model number.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model number sticker on the back of the console.

proof_requests: Photo of the model number sticker on the back of the top console.
Video of the consoles booting up and running a game.
Photo of the front of the consoles to confirm the model (Pro vs Standard).
Photo of the rear ports and cables to check for damage.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
